meta.promptText: Which serum should I buy for acne-prone skin in India under ₹700?

response.text:
For **acne-prone skin in India under ₹700**, the safest single pick is a **niacinamide serum** if your main issues are oiliness, pores, and post-acne marks; a budget ranking lists **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** at **₹219** as the top affordable option.[1] If you have **active breakouts** rather than just marks, a **salicylic acid serum** is usually the better ingredient class for oily, acne-prone skin because it helps unclog pores and control excess oil.[13][19]

A practical way to choose:
- **For oil control + acne marks:** **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** — best value under ₹700 in the provided ranking.[1]
- **For active acne/pimples:** look for a **salicylic acid serum** under ₹700; Plum’s acne-focused salicylic acid serum is explicitly positioned for acne-prone/oily skin, though the result shown does not confirm its exact under-₹700 price in the snippet.[13]
- **For a gentler acne-prone option:** **Niacinamide + Cica** formulas are commonly recommended for oily, acne-prone, sensitive skin.[9][19]

If you want just one recommendation without overthinking it, buy **Foxtale 12% Niacinamide Clarifying Serum** first for acne-prone skin under ₹700.[1]

If you tell me your skin type more specifically—**oily**, **sensitive**, **active acne**, or **acne marks**—I can narrow it to the best single serum.
